1.e4 e6 2.d4 a6 3.c4 b5.name: French Defence: St. George Defence, Sanky-George Gambit

1.e4 e6 2.d4 a6 3.c4 b5 4.cxb5.strategy: Accepts the gambit, the principal answer: White takes the pawn and, after Black's recapture, can win the loose pawn on b5 with the f1-bishop. The price is some time, since Black gets an open a-file against the a2 pawn, so White has to consolidate carefully.

1.e4 e6 2.d4 a6 3.c4 b5 4.cxb5 axb5.strategy: The natural recapture and the point of the gambit: the a-pawn leaves the a-file, so the rook looks at a2, and White must decide whether the loose pawn on b5 is worth taking. Not recapturing would leave Black a pawn down for nothing.
1.e4 e6 2.d4 a6 3.c4 b5 4.cxb5 axb5.name: French Defence: St. George Defence, St. George Gambit
